def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

lib = '''from collections import Counter

def background(grid):
    """The most common cell color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def uniform_rows(grid, color=None):
    """Indices of rows that are one color throughout; if color given, only that color."""
    return [i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
            if len(set(row)) == 1 and (color is None or row[0] == color)]

def uniform_cols(grid, color=None):
    """Indices of columns that are one color throughout; if color given, only that color."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    return [j for j in range(w)
            if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and (color is None or grid[0][j] == color)]

def regions(grid, bg=None):
    """Subgrids split by full separator rows/columns (any uniform non-background line); returns (r0,r1,c0,c1) bounds excluding separators."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if bg is None:
        bg = background(grid)
    sep_rows = uniform_rows(grid) and [i for i in uniform_rows(grid) if grid[i][0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [j for j in uniform_cols(grid) if grid[0][j] != bg]
    rb = sorted({0, h} | {x for i in sep_rows for x in (i, i + 1)})
    cb = sorted({0, w} | {x for j in sep_cols for x in (j, j + 1)})
    return [(rb[k], rb[k + 1], cb[l], cb[l + 1]) for k in range(len(rb) - 1) for l in range(len(cb) - 1)]

def fill_empty_regions(grid):
    """Copy the single non-uniform region (between separator lines) into every other region of the same size, keeping separators."""
    regs = regions(grid)
    content = [r for r in regs
               if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(r[0], r[1]) for j in range(r[2], r[3])}) > 1]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = content[0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for (a, b, c, d) in regs:
        if (a, b, c, d) != (r0, r1, c0, c1) and (b - a, d - c) == (r1 - r0, c1 - c0):
            for i in range(a, b):
                for j in range(c, d):
                    out[i][j] = grid[r0 + i - a][c0 + j - c]
    return out
'''
